class.name: OpenXRStationaryReferenceSpaceExtension
class.description: This extension provides the [code]STATIONARY[/code] reference space. Unlike the [code]LOCAL[/code] reference space, the runtime is allowed to redefine the origin of the [code]STATIONARY[/code] space at any time it determines this is necessary, without emitting a reference space change event. This makes it a good choice on devices, such as handheld AR phones, where a fixed [code]LOCAL[/code] origin may not always be well defined. Since such changes are not signaled through events, use [method get_generation_id] to detect them: whenever the returned identifier changes, the origin of the space has been redefined and any previously cached transforms relative to it should be considered stale. You can select this reference space through the [member ProjectSettings.xr/openxr/reference_space] project setting.

method.name: get_generation_id
method.description: Returns the current generation ID of the [code]STATIONARY[/code] reference space as a UUID string, or an empty string on failure. This value changes whenever the runtime redefines the origin of the space, and can be polled to detect this.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this extension is available.
